title: Fry Crusted Squash Delight
description: A crunchy exterior and a soft interior, this dish is perfect for a snack or side.
instructions: 2. Peel the squash and slice it into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together the fry and wholesome oil.
4. Toss the squash slices in the fry mixture to coat evenly.
5. Place the coated squash slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Sprinkle the Jamaican seasoning and salt over the squash.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the squash is tender and the exterior is crispy.
